node: Semiconductor equipment, specialty materials, and qualification-gated tooling
summary: Expanded the semiconductor equipment/materials qualification node into a two-lane universe: ASML as the obvious reference chokepoint for advanced lithography, and three underfollowed US-listed subsystem/test suppliers one or two steps below wafer-fab equipment OEMs. The strongest underfollowed candidates in this pass are gas/chemical/fluid delivery subsystem suppliers and semiconductor test/inspection vendors, where qualification, cleanliness, uptime, and customer-specific integration can create slower-to-replace supply-chain positions. AI exposure is mostly indirect and should be treated as inference until verified through customer mix, backlog tied to advanced logic/DRAM/HBM/advanced packaging, and capex-cycle evidence.
